newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to trade Ingram Micro, New Holland options.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to trade Ingram Micro, New Holland options.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said Monday it would begin trading options on Ingram Micro Inc and New Holland NV on February 10.
It said Ingram Micro options would have opening strike prices of 17-1/2, 20 and 22-1/2, with initial expirations in February, March, June and September.
It set position limits of 10,500 contracts.
For New Holland options, opening strikes have been set at 20, 22-1/2 and 25 and initial expirations in February, March, June and September. Position limits of 10,500 contracts have been set.
The PHLX said Gateway Partners has been selected as the specialist for both sets of options.
